thread:
Nora: FYI Sales flagged a sustained p95 regression for Heartwave (dedicated eu-central). Putting intake here to decide scope/prio. Ticket + customer graphs: https://support.redwood.example/t/HEART-4321
Sam: Heartwave reports the regression after last night's rollout. They're hitting p95 ~700ms (SLA is 250ms). QPS ~8-12, model `med-gpt-3-quant`.
Mei: Support added logs. No change to routing in their account. Release notes show runtime bump to runt-2.15 and model variant swap to `med-gpt-3-quant-2`.
Arjun: quick check 1: runtime image changed plus a few kernel optimizations. Nothing obvious but we'll repro. Can someone share a redacted sample + seq length distro?
Sam: Customer shared a scrubbed sample and seqs: most requests 300-900 tokens, occasional ~1500. Payload: `{"prompt":"Extract meds and dosages...","max_tokens":256}`
Casey: infra-bot: deploy run runt-2.15 finished 2026-03-22T02:30:05Z
Nora: For prioritization, I'm leaning P1 since it's a paid Dedicated customer with an SLA breach. Product asks for: 1) immediate mitigation plan (rollback vs workaround), 2) closure criteria, 3) backlog ticket with acceptance tests. Thoughts?
Arjun: Immediate mitigation: canary rollback to runt-2.14 on their pool. Risk: other customers on same pool may see regressions from rollback. Estimate ~45m to canary + 30m to full rollback if green. Alternative hotfix: tweak autoscaler/min-ready and pre-warm KV cache, ~20-60m depending on config churn.
Mei: Customer demands hourly updates. Also asking whether they'll get SLA credits if we don't restore within 24h. Sales will handle credits but need timeline.
Sam: Noted. Sales prefers minimal customer disruption. If rollback is low-risk we'll do it; otherwise route them to alternate pool (manual routing) as a 2-hr stopgap.
Arjun: I'll run targeted load in staging that mimics 10 qps with token distribution. If p95 reproduces under runt-2.15 but not 2.14, that's strong signal. Will post flamegraphs + heap diffs.
Casey: Also flagging CI: we currently don't have a gating test that covers quantized variants and long-seq tails. Product: consider adding a synthetic scenario to CI for med-gpt-3-quant-2.
Nora: Closure criteria suggestion: 1) cause identified and mitigation deployed OR rollback validated; 2) p95 <= 300ms for 2 hours under similar load; 3) customer update with root cause and remediation plan. Agree?
Mei: Agreed. Add requirement: postmortem within 5 business days and decision on pinning their pool if we accept risk.
Arjun: Starting repro now. Early observation: p50 unchanged, p95 spikes align with nodes that had cold KV-caches after the runtime change. Suspect cache preservation semantics changed in runt-2.15 for quantized models.
deploy-bot: rollback plan created: rollback-run-2234567999 (requires manual approval)
Nora: If it's cache warmup we can push a config to increase per-node warmup and set baseline min-ready to keep nodes warm; lower blast radius than rollback. Time to implement and validate?
Arjun: Patch config + canary test ~25-40m. If that fixes, we avoid full rollback. If not, proceed to rollback.
Sam: Customer prefers minimal config fiddling if it risks more variability. They're okay with a rollback if it's quick.
Mei: I'll draft the customer update: initial acknowledgement + ETA for next update in 1 hour. Also mention we may do a rollback as option.
Nora: Product asks Eng to sketch out acceptance tests for the backlog ticket: synthetic load with quantized variant, seq tail 1500 tokens, assert p95 < 300ms for 10 qps for 1 hour. Also add CI gating for future runtime bumps.
Arjun: Will add logs + flamegraphs to ticket and tag eng-runtime. If cache semantics are root cause, will propose a runtime compatibility test for quantized variants.
Mei: Ticket created: PROD-HEART-4321-HOTFIX. Linked this thread and attached initial customer update.
Sam: Customer confirmed they got update. They've accepted routing to a backup pool for 2 hours if we need that window.
Casey: Action items recap: Arjun repro + logs (eng), Casey start rollback approval flow if config change fails (infra), Nora coordinate comms & backlog prioritization (product), Mei maintain customer updates (support).
Nora: We'll reconvene in this thread after Arjun posts repro results. Thanks all.
